endpoints.title: Revert Account
endpoints.description: Recovers an account after account takeover. This endpoint will: - Invalidate the revert token used - Invalidate all authorization tokens and active Gateway sessions associated with the account - Set the account's email back to the original - Set the account's password to the one provided - Remove MFA from the account - Remove and blacklist all phone numbers previously associated with the account

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The revert token from the recovery email

JSON Params.name: password
JSON Params.description: The new password for the account

Response Body.name: email
Response Body.description: The account's restored email

JSON Params.name: data ^1^

endpoints.title: Get Gateway
endpoints.description: Returns an object with a single valid WebSocket URL, which the client can use for [Connecting](#connecting). Clients **should** cache this value and only call this endpoint to retrieve a new URL if they are unable to properly establish a connection using the cached one.

Response Body.name: url
Response Body.description: The WebSocket URL that can be used for connecting to the Gateway

endpoints.title: Get Gateway Bot
endpoints.description: Returns an object based on the information in [Get Gateway](#get-gateway), plus additional metadata that can help during the operation of large or [sharded](#sharding) bots. Unlike [Get Gateway](#get-gateway), this route should not be cached for extended periods of time as the value is not guaranteed to be the same per-call, and changes as the user joins/leaves guilds.

Response Body.name: url
Response Body.description: The WebSocket URL that can be used for connecting to the Gateway

Response Body.name: shards
Response Body.description: The recommended number of [shards](#sharding) to use when connecting

Response Body.name: session_start_limit
Response Body.description: Information on the current session start limit

endpoints.title: Get Application Command Index
endpoints.description: Returns an [application command index](#application-command-index-object) object for the given application ID, containing all of the application's available commands. User must have the application authorized on their account.

endpoints.title: Get Channel Application Command Index
endpoints.description: Returns an [application command index](#application-command-index-object) object for the given private channel ID. endpoints.title: Get Guild Application Command Index
endpoints.description: Returns an [application command index](#application-command-index-object) object for the given guild ID, containing the commands available from all applications installed to the guild. User must be a member of the guild.

endpoints.title: Get User Application Command Index
endpoints.description: Returns an [application command index](#application-command-index-object) object for the current user, containing the commands available from all applications installed to the user's account.

endpoints.title: List Global Application Commands
endpoints.description: Returns a list of global [application command](#application-command-object) objects for the given application ID. User must be the owner of the application, developer of the application's team, or have a DM channel with the application's bot.

endpoints.title: Create Interaction Response
endpoints.description: Create a response to an interaction from the Gateway. Accepts an [interaction response](#interaction-response-object) object. Returns a 204 empty response or the object below depending on the `with_response` parameter. This endpoint also supports file attachments similar to the webhook endpoints. Refer to [Uploading Files](/reference#uploading-files) for details on uploading files and `multipart/form-data` requests.

Query String Params.name: with_response
Query String Params.description: Whether to include an interaction callback result as the response (default false)

Response Body.description: The interaction associated with the interaction response

endpoints.title: Get Original Interaction Response
endpoints.description: Returns the initial interaction response. Functions the same as [Get Webhook Message](/resources/webhook#get-webhook-message).

endpoints.title: Modify Original Interaction Response
endpoints.description: Edits the initial interaction response. Functions the same as [Edit Webhook Message](/resources/webhook#edit-webhook-message).

endpoints.title: Delete Original Interaction Response
endpoints.description: Deletes the initial interaction response. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

endpoints.title: Create Followup Message
endpoints.description: Create a followup message for an interaction. Functions the same as [Execute Webhook](/resources/webhook#execute-webhook), but `wait` is always true, and `flags` can have `EPHEMERAL` flag to send an ephemeral message. The `thread_id` query parameter is ignored when using this endpoint for interaction followups.

endpoints.title: Get Followup Message
endpoints.description: Returns a followup message for an interaction. Functions the same as [Get Webhook Message](/resources/webhook#get-webhook-message). Does not support ephemeral followups.

endpoints.title: Modify Followup Message
endpoints.description: Edits a followup message for an interaction. Functions the same as [Edit Webhook Message](/resources/webhook#edit-webhook-message). Does not support ephemeral followups.

endpoints.title: Delete Followup Message
endpoints.description: Deletes a followup message for an interaction. Functions the same as [Delete Webhook Message](/resources/webhook#delete-webhook-message). Does not support ephemeral followups.

endpoints.title: Create Interaction

endpoints.title: Exchange Remote Auth Ticket
endpoints.description: Exchanges a remote auth ticket for an [authentication token](/reference#authentication). The token must be decrypted using the client's private key. An example in Python pseudocode would be: ```py encrypted_token_bytes = base64.b64decode(encrypted_token) token = private_key.decrypt( encrypted_token_bytes, padding.OAEP(mgf=padding.MGF1(algorithm=hashes.SHA256()), algorithm=hashes.SHA256(), label=None), ).decode("utf-8") ```

endpoints.title: Delete Channel
endpoints.description: Deletes a channel, or closes a private message. Requires the `MANAGE_CHANNELS` permission for the guild, or `MANAGE_THREADS` if the channel is a thread. Deleting a category does not delete its child channels; they will have their `parent_id` removed and a [Channel Update](/gateway/gateway-events#channel-update) Gateway event will fire for each of them. Returns a [channel](#channel-object) object on success. Fires a [Channel Delete](/gateway/gateway-events#channel-delete) or [Thread Delete](/gateway/gateway-events#thread-delete) Gateway event.

Only permissions you have in the guild or parent channel (if applicable) can be allowed/denied (unless you have a `MANAGE_ROLES` overwrite in the channel). Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [Channel Update](/gateway/gateway-events#channel-update) Gateway event. For more information about permissions, see [permissions](/topics/permissions#permissions).

Requires the `VIEW_CHANNEL` permission and the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission on the entity being added. Returns the new [directory entry](#directory-entry-object) object on success. Fires a [Guild Directory Entry Create](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-directory-entry-create) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: type
JSON Params.description: The [type of directory entry](#directory-entry-type) to create (default `GUILD`)

JSON Params.name: primary_category_id
JSON Params.description: The [primary category](#directory-category) of the entry (default `UNCATEGORIZED`)

JSON Params.name: description
JSON Params.description: The description of the entry (max 200 characters)

endpoints.title: Modify Directory Entry
endpoints.description: Modifies an existing directory entry in the given directory channel. Requires the `VIEW_CHANNEL` permission and the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission on the entity being modified. Returns the updated [directory entry](#directory-entry-object) object on success. Fires a [Guild Directory Entry Update](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-directory-entry-update) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: primary_category_id
JSON Params.description: The [primary category](#directory-category) of the entry

JSON Params.name: description
JSON Params.description: The description of the entry (max 200 characters)

endpoints.title: Delete Directory Entry
endpoints.description: Deletes a directory entry in the given directory channel. Requires the `VIEW_CHANNEL` permission and the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission on the entity being deleted. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [Guild Directory Entry Delete](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-directory-entry-delete) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: Get Directory Broadcast Info
endpoints.description: Returns the broadcast information for the given guild and directory entry type. User must be a member of the guild.

Response Body.name: can_broadcast
Response Body.description: Whether the user can broadcast in any linked directory channels

Response Body.name: has_broadcast? ^1^
Response Body.description: Whether the entity has been broadcasted in any directory channels

endpoints.title: List Discoverable Guilds
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [discoverable guild](#discoverable-guild-object) objects representing the guilds that are available for the current user to discover.

Query String Params.name: guild_ids? ^1^
Query String Params.description: The IDs of the discoverable guilds to return (max 48)

Query String Params.name: application_ids? ^1^
Query String Params.description: The IDs of the applications to return matching discoverable guilds for (max 48)

Query String Params.name: categories? ^1^
Query String Params.description: The IDs of the [discovery categories](#discovery-category-object) to filter results by

Query String Params.name: limit? ^2^
Query String Params.description: The maximum number of guilds to return (max 48, default 30)

Query String Params.name: offset? ^2^
Query String Params.description: Number of guilds to skip before returning guilds

Response Body.name: guilds
Response Body.description: The guilds that match the query

Response Body.name: total
Response Body.description: The total number of guilds that match the query

Response Body.name: limit
Response Body.description: The number of guilds returned in the response

Response Body.name: offset
Response Body.description: The number of guilds skipped before returning guilds

endpoints.title: Search Discoverable Guilds
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [discoverable guild](#discoverable-guild-object) objects that match the query.

Query String Params.name: query
Query String Params.description: The query to match (max 100 characters)

Query String Params.name: limit
Query String Params.description: The maximum number of guilds to return (max 48, default 24)

Query String Params.name: offset
Query String Params.description: Number of guilds to skip before returning guilds (max 2999)

Query String Params.name: category_id
Query String Params.description: The ID of the [discovery category](#discovery-category-object) to filter results by

endpoints.title: Search Published Guilds
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [discoverable guild](#discoverable-guild-object) objects that have a landing web page and match the query. This endpoint is a proxy for [searching using the Algolia API](#searching-discovery). See the [Algolia Search documentation](https://www.algolia.com/doc/rest-api/search/) for more information.

Query String Params.name: query
Query String Params.description: The query to match

Query String Params.name: limit
Query String Params.description: The maximum number of guilds to return (1-48, default 48)

Query String Params.name: offset
Query String Params.description: Number of guilds to skip before returning guilds (max 2999)

endpoints.title: Get Discovery Slug
endpoints.description: Returns information about a guild's landing web page or monetization store page. This endpoint requires the guild to either be discoverable and [published](#discovery-metadata-object) or have the [`CREATOR_STORE_PAGE` guild feature](/resources/guild#guild-features).

Response Body.name: slug
Response Body.description: The guild's discovery slug; can be appended to `https://discord.com/servers/` to get the guild's discovery page

Response Body.name: guild
Response Body.description: The guild information, if the guild is discoverable

Response Body.name: store_page
Response Body.description: The guild's monetization store page, if enabled

endpoints.title: List Discovery Categories
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [discovery category](#discovery-category-object) objects representing the available discovery categories.

Query String Params.name: locale
Query String Params.description: The [language](/reference#locales) to return category names in (default "en-US")

Query String Params.name: primary_only
Query String Params.description: Whether to only return categories that can be set as a guild's primary category (default false)

endpoints.title: Validate Discovery Search Term
endpoints.description: Checks if a discovery search term is allowed.

Query String Params.name: term
Query String Params.description: The search term to validate

Response Body.name: valid
Response Body.description: Whether the provided term is valid

endpoints.title: Get Guild Discovery Requirements
endpoints.description: Returns the [discovery requirements](#discovery-requirements-object) object for the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission.

endpoints.title: Get Guild Discovery Metadata
endpoints.description: Returns the [discovery metadata](#discovery-metadata-object) object for the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission.

endpoints.title: Modify Guild Discovery Metadata
endpoints.description: Replaces the discovery metadata for the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Returns the updated [discovery metadata](#discovery-metadata-object) object on success.

JSON Params.name: primary_category_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the primary [discovery category](#discovery-category-object) set for the guild (default 0)

JSON Params.name: keywords
JSON Params.description: The discovery search keywords for the guild (max 10)

JSON Params.name: emoji_discoverability_enabled
JSON Params.description: Whether the guild is shown as a source through custom emoji and stickers (default true)

JSON Params.name: is_published
JSON Params.description: Whether the guild's landing web page is currently published (default false)

JSON Params.name: reasons_to_join
JSON Params.description: The reasons to join the guild shown in the discovery web page (max 4)

JSON Params.name: social_links
JSON Params.description: The guild's social media links shown in the discovery web page (max 256 characters, max 9)

JSON Params.name: about
JSON Params.description: The guild's long description shown in the discovery web page (max 2400 characters)

endpoints.title: Add Guild Discovery Subcategory
endpoints.description: Adds a [discovery subcategory](#discovery-category-object) to the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

endpoints.title: Remove Guild Discovery Subcategory
endpoints.description: Removes a [discovery subcategory](#discovery-category-object) from the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

endpoints.title: Get Guild Profile
endpoints.description: Returns a [guild profile](#guild-profile-object) object for the given guild ID. User must be a member of the guild or the guild must be discoverable or have a [`PUBLIC` or `PUBLIC_WITH_RECRUITMENT` visibility](#guild-visibility).

endpoints.title: Modify Guild Profile
endpoints.description: Modifies the [guild profile](#guild-profile-object) for the given guild ID. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Returns the updated [guild profile](#guild-profile-object) object on success.

endpoints.title: List Guild Emojis
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [emoji](#emoji-object) objects for the given guild. Includes the `user` field if the user has the `CREATE_EXPRESSIONS` or `MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS` permission.

endpoints.title: Get Guild Emoji
endpoints.description: Returns an [emoji](#emoji-object) object for the given guild and emoji IDs. Includes the `user` field if the user has the `CREATE_EXPRESSIONS` or `MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS` permission.

endpoints.title: List Guild Top Emojis
endpoints.description: Returns the most-used emojis for the given guild.

Response Body.name: items
Response Body.description: The most-used emojis for the guild

endpoints.title: Get Emoji Guild
endpoints.description: Returns a [discoverable guild](/resources/discovery#discoverable-guild-object) object for the guild that owns the given emoji. This endpoint requires the guild to be discoverable, not be [auto-removed](/resources/discovery#discoverable-guild-object), and have [guild expression discoverability](/resources/discovery#discovery-metadata-object) enabled.

endpoints.title: Get Emoji Source
endpoints.description: Returns an object containing information on the guild or application that owns the given emoji. If the source is a guild, this endpoint requires the guild to be discoverable, not be [auto-removed](/resources/discovery#discoverable-guild-object), and have [guild expression discoverability](/resources/discovery#discovery-metadata-object) enabled.

Response Body.name: type
Response Body.description: The [type of emoji source](#emoji-source-type)

Response Body.name: guild
Response Body.description: The guild that owns the given emoji

Response Body.name: application
Response Body.description: The application that owns the given emoji

endpoints.title: Create Guild Emoji
endpoints.description: Creates a new emoji for the guild. Requires the `CREATE_EXPRESSIONS` permission. Returns the new [emoji](#emoji-object) object on success. Fires a [Guild Emojis Update](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-emojis-update) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: name
JSON Params.description: The name of the emoji (2-32 characters)

JSON Params.name: image
JSON Params.description: 128x128 emoji image

JSON Params.name: roles
JSON Params.description: The roles allowed to use this emoji

endpoints.title: Modify Guild Emoji
endpoints.description: Modifies the given emoji. For emoji created by the current user, requires either the `CREATE_EXPRESSIONS` or `MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS` permission. For other emojis, requires the `MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS` permission. Returns the updated [emoji](#emoji-object) object on success. Fires a [Guild Emojis Update](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-emojis-update) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: name
JSON Params.description: The name of the emoji (2-32 characters)

JSON Params.name: roles
JSON Params.description: The roles allowed to use this emoji

endpoints.title: Delete Guild Emoji
endpoints.description: Deletes the given emoji. For emoji created by the current user, requires either the `CREATE_EXPRESSIONS` or `MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS` permission. For other emojis, requires the `MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS` permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [Guild Emojis Update](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-emojis-update) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: List Application Emojis
endpoints.description: Returns an object containing a list of [emoji](#emoji-object) objects for the given application under the `items` key. Includes the `user` field.

Response Body.name: items
Response Body.description: The emoji uploaded to the application

endpoints.title: Get Application Emoji
endpoints.description: Returns an [emoji](#emoji-object) object for the given application and emoji IDs. Includes the `user` field.

endpoints.title: Create Application Emoji
endpoints.description: Creates a new emoji for the application. Returns the new [emoji](#emoji-object) object on success.

JSON Params.name: name ^1^
JSON Params.description: The name of the emoji (2-32 characters)

JSON Params.name: image
JSON Params.description: 128x128 emoji image

endpoints.title: Modify Application Emoji
endpoints.description: Modifies the given emoji. Returns the updated [emoji](#emoji-object) object on success.

JSON Params.name: name? ^1^
JSON Params.description: The name of the emoji (2-32 characters)

endpoints.title: Delete Application Emoji
endpoints.description: Deletes the given emoji. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

Otherwise, requires both the `MANAGE_GUILD` and `KICK_MEMBERS` permissions. By default, prune will not remove users with roles. For large guilds, it's recommended to set the `compute_prune_count` option to `false`, allowing the request to return before all members are pruned. Fires multiple [Guild Member Remove](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-member-remove) Gateway events. By default, prune will not remove users with roles. You can optionally include specific roles in your prune by providing

endpoints.title: Delete Guild Product Listing
endpoints.description: Deletes the guild product listing. Requires the `ADMINISTRATOR` permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

endpoints.title: Get Guild Product Listing Attachment URL
endpoints.description: Returns a URL to the attachment for the given guild and product ID. Requires an entitlement to the product or the `ADMINISTRATOR` permission.

Response Body.name: url
Response Body.description: The URL to the attachment

endpoints.title: List Guild Integrations
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [integration](#integration-object) objects for the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission.

endpoints.title: Create Guild Integration
endpoints.description: Enables an integration for the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires [Guild Integrations Update](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-integrations-update) and [Integration Create](/gateway/gateway-events#integration-create) Gateway events.

JSON Params.name: type
JSON Params.description: The [type of integration](#integration-type) to enable (only `twitch` and `youtube` are supported)

JSON Params.name: id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the integration account to enable

endpoints.title: Sync Guild Integration
endpoints.description: Syncs an integration for the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires [Guild Integrations Update](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-integrations-update) and [Integration Update](/gateway/gateway-events#integration-update) Gateway events.

endpoints.title: Modify Guild Integration
endpoints.description: Modifies the behavior and settings of the integration in the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires [Guild Integrations Update](#integration-object) and [Integration Update](#integration-object) Gateway events.

JSON Params.name: expire_behavior
JSON Params.description: The [behavior of expiring subscribers](#integration-expire-behavior)

JSON Params.name: expire_grace_period
JSON Params.description: The grace period before expiring subscribers (one of 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, in days)

JSON Params.name: enable_emoticons
JSON Params.description: Whether emoticons should be synced for this integration (Twitch only)

endpoints.title: Delete Guild Integration
endpoints.description: Removes the given integration ID from the guild. Deletes any associated webhooks and kicks the associated bot (if there is one). Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires [Guild Integrations Update](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-integrations-update), [Integration Delete](/gateway/gateway-events#integration-delete), and optionally [Guild Member Remove](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-member-remove) and [Webhooks Update](/gateway/gateway-events#webhooks-update) Gateway events.

endpoints.title: Migrate Guild Command Scope
endpoints.description: Migrates all Discord application integrations in the guild to the [`applications.commands` OAuth2 scope](/topics/oauth2#oauth2-scopes). Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission. Fires a [Guild Integrations Update](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-integrations-update) and multiple [Integration Update](/gateway/gateway-events#integration-update) Gateway events.

Response Body.name: integration_ids_with_app_commands
Response Body.description: The IDs of migrated integrations that now have application commands registered

endpoints.title: Get Guild Integration Application IDs
endpoints.description: Returns a mapping of guild IDs to lists of application IDs attached to the integrations in the current user's guilds.

endpoints.title: List Channel Integrations
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [integration](#integration-object) objects for the private channel.

endpoints.title: Delete Channel Integration
endpoints.description: Removes the given integration ID from the channel. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires an [Integration Delete](#integration-object) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: Join Integration Guild
endpoints.description: Joins the user to the given integration ID's guild. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [Guild Create](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-create) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: List Trending GIF Search Terms
endpoints.description: Returns a list of the top trending search terms.

endpoints.title: List Suggested GIF Search Terms
endpoints.description: Returns a list of recommended search terms based on the provided query.

endpoints.title: Search GIFs
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [GIF](#gif-structure) objects based on the provided query.

endpoints.title: List Trending GIF Categories
endpoints.description: Returns trending GIF categories and their associated preview GIFs.

Response Body.name: categories
Response Body.description: The trending GIF categories

Response Body.name: gifs
Response Body.description: A trending GIF to use as a placeholder

endpoints.title: List Trending GIFs
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [GIF](#gif-structure) objects that are currently trending.

endpoints.title: Track Selected GIF
endpoints.description: Tracks the selection of a GIF by the user. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

JSON Params.name: id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the selected GIF

JSON Params.name: q
JSON Params.description: The search query used to find the GIF

endpoints.title: Get Invite
endpoints.description: Returns an [invite](#invite-object) object for the given code.

Query String Params.name: with_counts
Query String Params.description: Whether the invite should contain approximate member counts (and partial recipients for group DM invites) (default false)

Query String Params.name: with_permissions
Query String Params.description: Whether the invite should contain permission-related fields (default false)

Query String Params.name: guild_scheduled_event_id
Query String Params.description: The guild scheduled event to include with the invite

endpoints.title: List Invite Friend Members
endpoints.description: Returns the user IDs of friends in the target guild. Always returns an empty array for group DMs and friend invites.

Response Body.name: friend_member_ids
Response Body.description: User IDs of friends in the target guild

endpoints.title: List Invite Target Users
endpoints.description: Returns the IDs of the users allowed to see and accept the given invite. Invite must have a target users file associated with it. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` or `VIEW_AUDIT_LOG` permission if the requestor is not the inviter. Return a CSV file with the header `user_id` and each user ID passed to [invite create](#create-channel-invite) on its own line.

endpoints.title: Update Invite Target Users
endpoints.description: Replaces the target users file associated with the given invite. Processing is done asynchronously. Invite must have been created with a target users file. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission if the requestor is not the inviter. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

Form Params.name: target_users_file ^1^
Form Params.description: A CSV file with a single column of user IDs to restrict the invite to

endpoints.title: Get Invite Target Users Job Status
endpoints.description: Returns an [invite target users job](#invite-target-users-job-object) object for the given invite. Invite must have a target users file associated with it. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` or `VIEW_AUDIT_LOG` permission if the requestor is not the inviter.

endpoints.title: Accept Invite
endpoints.description: Accepts an invite to a [guild](#invite-guild-object), [group DM](/resources/channel#channel-object), or [DM](/resources/channel#channel-object). Returns an [invite](#invite-object) object on success. May fire a [Guild Create](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-create), [Guild Member Add](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-member-add), [Guild Join Request Create](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-join-request-create), [Channel Create](/gateway/gateway-events#channel-create), and/or [Relationship Add](/gateway/gateway-events#relationship-add) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: session_id
JSON Params.description: The session ID that is accepting the invite, required for [guest invites](#guest-invites)

endpoints.title: Delete Invite
endpoints.description: Deletes an invite. Requires the `MANAGE_CHANNELS` permission on the channel this invite belongs to, or `MANAGE_GUILD` to remove any invite across the guild, if the invite is to a guild. Returns an [invite](#invite-object) object on success. May fire an [Invite Delete](/gateway/gateway-events#invite-delete) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: List Guild Invites
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [invite](#invite-object) objects for the guild. Requires the `MANAGE_GUILD` or `VIEW_AUDIT_LOG` permission. [Invite metadata](#invite-metadata-object) is included if the user has the `MANAGE_GUILD` permission.

endpoints.title: List Channel Invites
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [invite](#invite-object) objects (with [invite metadata](#invite-metadata-object)) for the channel. Only usable for guild channels and group DMs. Requires the `MANAGE_CHANNELS` permission if the channel is in a guild.

endpoints.title: Create Channel Invite
endpoints.description: Creates a new [invite](#invite-object) object for the channel. Only usable for guild channels and group DMs. Requires the `CREATE_INSTANT_INVITE` permission if the channel is in a guild. Returns an [invite](#invite-object) object (with [invite metadata](#invite-metadata-object)). Fires an [Invite Create](/gateway/gateway-events#invite-create) Gateway event if the channel is in a guild.

JSON/Form Params.name: flags? ^1^
JSON/Form Params.description: The [invite's flags](#invite-flags) (only `IS_GUEST_INVITE` and `IS_APPLICATION_BYPASS` can be set)

JSON/Form Params.name: max_age? ^2^
JSON/Form Params.description: Number of seconds before expiry, or 0 for never (0-5184000, default 86400)

JSON/Form Params.name: max_uses
JSON/Form Params.description: Max number of uses or 0 for unlimited (0-100, default 0)

JSON/Form Params.name: temporary
JSON/Form Params.description: Whether the invite only grants temporary membership (default false)

JSON/Form Params.name: unique
JSON/Form Params.description: Whether to try to reuse a similar invite (useful for creating many unique one time use invites, default false)

JSON/Form Params.name: target_type
JSON/Form Params.description: The [type of target](#invite-target-type) for the invite

JSON/Form Params.name: target_user_id
JSON/Form Params.description: The ID of the user whose stream to display for the invite, required if `target_type` is `STREAM`; the user must be streaming in the channel

JSON/Form Params.name: target_application_id
JSON/Form Params.description: The ID of the embedded application to open for the invite, required if `target_type` is `EMBEDDED_APPLICATION`; the application must have the `EMBEDDED` flag

JSON/Form Params.name: target_users_file? ^3^
JSON/Form Params.description: A CSV file with a single column of user IDs to restrict the invite to

JSON/Form Params.name: role_ids? ^4^
JSON/Form Params.description: The IDs of the roles to grant to the invitee upon acceptance

endpoints.title: List User Invites
endpoints.description: Returns a list of friend [invite](#invite-object) objects (with [invite metadata](#invite-metadata-object)) for the current user.

endpoints.title: Create User Invite
endpoints.description: Creates a new friend invite. Returns a friend [invite](#invite-object) object (with [invite metadata](#invite-metadata-object)) on success.

JSON Params.name: code
JSON Params.description: The pre-generated friend invite code to create an invite from

endpoints.title: Revoke User Invites
endpoints.description: Revokes all of the current user's friend invites. Returns a list of revoked friend [invite](#invite-object) objects (with [invite metadata](#invite-metadata-object)) on success.

endpoints.title: Create Lobby
endpoints.description: Creates a new lobby. Returns a [lobby](#lobby-object) object on success. Fires a [Lobby Create](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-create) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: metadata
JSON Params.description: The metadata of the lobby (max 25 keys, 1024 characters per key and value)

JSON Params.name: members
JSON Params.description: The members of the lobby (max 25)

JSON Params.name: idle_timeout_seconds
JSON Params.description: How long to wait (in seconds) before shutting down a lobby after it becomes idle (min 5, max 604800, default 300)

JSON Params.name: flags
JSON Params.description: The [lobby flags](#lobby-flags)

endpoints.title: Join or Create Lobby
endpoints.description: Joins an existing lobby or creates a new lobby. Returns a [lobby](#lobby-object) object on success. May fire a [Lobby Create](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-create) or [Lobby Member Add](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-member-add) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: secret ^1^
JSON Params.description: The lobby secret (max 250 characters)

JSON Params.name: lobby_metadata
JSON Params.description: The metadata of the lobby (max 25 keys, 1024 characters per key and value)

JSON Params.name: member_metadata
JSON Params.description: The metadata of the lobby member (max 25 keys, 1024 characters per key and value)

JSON Params.name: idle_timeout_seconds
JSON Params.description: How long to wait (in seconds) before shutting down a lobby after it becomes idle (min 5, max 604800, default 300)

JSON Params.name: flags
JSON Params.description: The [lobby flags](#lobby-flags)

endpoints.title: Get Lobby
endpoints.description: Returns a [lobby](#lobby-object) object for the given lobby ID. User must be a member of the lobby.

endpoints.title: Modify Lobby
endpoints.description: Modifies a lobby's settings. Application must be the creator of the lobby. Returns the updated [lobby](#lobby-object) object on success. Fires a [Lobby Update](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-update) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: metadata
JSON Params.description: The metadata of the lobby (max 25 keys, 1024 characters per key and value)

JSON Params.name: members
JSON Params.description: The members of the lobby (max 25)

JSON Params.name: idle_timeout_seconds
JSON Params.description: How long to wait (in seconds) before shutting down a lobby after it becomes idle (min 5, max 604800)

JSON Params.name: flags
JSON Params.description: The [lobby flags](#lobby-flags)

endpoints.title: Delete Lobby
endpoints.description: Deletes a lobby. Application must be the creator of the lobby. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [Lobby Delete](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-delete) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: Add Lobby Member
endpoints.description: Adds a member to the lobby. Returns the [lobby member](#lobby-member-object) object. Fires a [Lobby Member Add](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-member-add) or [Lobby Member Update](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-member-update) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: metadata
JSON Params.description: The metadata of the lobby member (max 25 keys, 1024 characters per key and value)

JSON Params.name: flags
JSON Params.description: The [lobby member's flags](#lobby-member-flags)

endpoints.title: Remove Lobby Member
endpoints.description: Removes a member from the lobby. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [Lobby Member Remove](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-member-remove) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: Leave Lobby
endpoints.description: Removes the current user from the lobby. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [Lobby Delete](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-delete) and [Lobby Member Remove](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-member-remove) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: Bulk Update Lobby Members
endpoints.description: Modifies multiple members in a lobby in a single request. Accepts a list of 1 to 25 [update lobby member](#update-lobby-member-structure) objects. Returns a list of [lobby member](#lobby-member-object) objects on success. May fire multiple [Lobby Member Add](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-member-add), and/or [Lobby Member Remove](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-member-remove) Gateway events.

endpoints.title: Create Lobby Invite for Current User
endpoints.description: Creates an invite for the channel linked to the lobby that can only be accepted by the current user. Fires an [Invite Create](/gateway/gateway-events#invite-create) Gateway event.

Response Body.name: code
Response Body.description: The code of the invite

endpoints.title: Create Lobby Invite
endpoints.description: Creates an invite for the channel linked to the lobby that can only be accepted by the specified user. Fires an [Invite Create](/gateway/gateway-events#invite-create) Gateway event.

Response Body.name: code
Response Body.description: The code of the invite

endpoints.title: Modify Lobby Linked Channel
endpoints.description: Links or unlinks a channel to the lobby. Returns a [lobby](#lobby-object) object on success. Fires a [Lobby Update](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-update) and [Channel Update](/gateway/gateway-events#channel-update) Gateway event. The application must be the creator of the lobby or the member must have the [`CAN_LINK_LOBBY` flag](#lobby-member-flags). Requires the `MANAGE_CHANNELS` permission in the target channel.

JSON Params.name: channel_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the channel to link to the lobby

endpoints.title: List Lobby Messages
endpoints.description: Returns a list of partial [message](/resources/message#message-object) objects in the lobby in reverse chronological order.

Query String Params.name: limit
Query String Params.description: Max number of messages to return (1-200, default 50)

endpoints.title: Create Lobby Message
endpoints.description: Posts a message to a lobby. Returns a partial [message](/resources/message#message-object) object on success. Fires a [Lobby Message Create](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-message-create) and [Message Create](/gateway/gateway-events#message-create) Gateway event. Functionally identical to the [Create Message](/resources/message#create-message) endpoint, but is used for lobbies in an OAuth2 context and has some additional parameters. Check there for more information.

Extra JSON Params.name: metadata
Extra JSON Params.description: Custom metadata for the message (max 25 keys, 1024 characters per key and value)

endpoints.title: Update Lobby Message Moderation Metadata
endpoints.description: Updates a lobby message's moderation metadata. Accepts a moderation metadata mapping, up to 5 keys, max 2000 characters per value. Returns a 204 empty response. Fires a [Lobby Message Update](/gateway/gateway-events#lobby-message-update) or [Message Update](/gateway/gateway-events#message-update) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: List Messages
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [message](#message-object) objects in the channel. Requires the `VIEW_CHANNEL` permission if operating on a guild channel. If the current user is missing the `READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY` permission in the channel then this will return no messages (since they cannot read the message history).

Query String Params.name: around
Query String Params.description: Get messages around this message ID

Query String Params.name: before
Query String Params.description: Get messages before this message ID

Query String Params.name: after
Query String Params.description: Get messages after this message ID

Query String Params.name: limit
Query String Params.description: Max number of messages to return (1-100, default 50)

endpoints.title: List DM Messages
endpoints.description: Returns a list of partial [message](#partial-message-structure) objects in the DM channel. This endpoint is subject to the following limitations: 1. A DM channel must already exist between the user and the recipient 1. Both users must have authorized the OAuth2 application for message history to be retrievable 1. Only a maximum of 200 messages and up to 72 hours of history can be retrieved

Query String Params.name: limit
Query String Params.description: Max number of messages to return (1-200, default 50)

endpoints.title: Preload Messages
endpoints.description: Preloads the last message sent in a series of private channels. Returns a list of [message](#message-object) objects without the `reactions` key.

JSON Body.name: channel_ids
JSON Body.description: The IDs of the channels to preload messages from (max 100)

Query String Params.name: max_id? ^6^

Query String Params.description: Get messages after this message ID

Query String Params.name: content

Query String Params.description: Filter messages by [tokenized content](#tokenized-content) (max 1024 characters, max 100)

Query String Params.name: channel_id? ^1^
Query String Params.description: Filter messages by these channels (max 500)

Query String Params.name: author_type
Query String Params.description: Filter messages by [author type](#author-type)

Query String Params.name: author_id

Query String Params.name: mentions

Query String Params.name: mentions_role_id

Query String Params.name: replied_to_user_id

Query String Params.name: replied_to_message_id
Query String Params.description: Filter messages that reply to these messages (max 100)

Query String Params.name: pinned

Query String Params.name: has

Query String Params.name: embed_type

Query String Params.name: link_hostname
Query String Params.description: Filter messages by link hostname (e.g. `discordapp.com`) (max 256 characters, max 100)

Query String Params.name: attachment_filename

Query String Params.name: command_id? ^3^ ^4^

Query String Params.name: sort_by? ^2^

Query String Params.name: sort_order? ^2^

Query String Params.name: include_nsfw? ^5^
Query String Params.description: Whether to include results from NSFW channels (default false)

Response Body.name: analytics_id

Response Body.name: doing_deep_historical_index

Response Body.name: total_results

endpoints.title: Search Channel Messages
endpoints.description: Returns a list of messages without the `reactions` key that match a search query in the private channel. See [Search Guild Messages](#search-guild-messages) for more information.

endpoints.title: Search Guild Messages by Tab
endpoints.description: Returns a list of messages without the `reactions` key that match a set of parallelized search queries in the guild. Requires the `READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY` permission.

Response Body.name: tabs

endpoints.title: Search Channel Messages by Tab
endpoints.description: Returns a list of messages without the `reactions` key that match a set of parallelized search queries in the private channel. See [Search Guild Messages by Tab](#search-guild-messages-by-tab) for more information.

endpoints.description: Returns a list of messages without the `reactions` key that match a set of parallelized search queries across all user private channels. See [Search Guild Messages by Tab](#search-guild-messages-by-tab) for more information.

endpoints.description: Returns a specific [message](#message-object) object in the channel. Requires the `READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY` permission if operating on a guild channel.

JSON Params.name: phone
JSON Params.description: The E.164-formatted phone number to send a verification code to

JSON Params.name: phone_token
JSON Params.description: The phone verification token received from the [phone registration flow](#adding-a-phone-number)

JSON Params.name: password
JSON Params.description: The user's current password; if the account does not have a password, this sets it

JSON Params.name: change_phone_reason
JSON Params.description: The [reason](#change-phone-reason) for adding a phone number

endpoints.title: Reverify Phone Number
endpoints.description: Reverifies a phone number for the current user. This endpoint should only be used when a [relevant required action](/resources/user#required-action-type) is received. The phone number provided must match the phone number currently associated with the account. Fires a [User Update](/gateway/gateway-events#user-update) and optionally a [User Required Action Update](/gateway/gateway-events#user-required-action-update) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: phone
JSON Params.description: The E.164-formatted phone number to send a verification code to

JSON Params.name: phone_token
JSON Params.description: The phone verification token received from the [phone registration flow](#adding-a-phone-number)

JSON Params.name: password
JSON Params.description: The user's current password; if the account does not have a password, this sets it

JSON Params.name: change_phone_reason
JSON Params.description: The [reason](#change-phone-reason) for adding a phone number

endpoints.title: Remove Phone Number
endpoints.description: Removes the phone number from the current user. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [User Update](/gateway/gateway-events#user-update) and optionally a [User Required Action Update](/gateway/gateway-events#user-required-action-update) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: password
JSON Params.description: The user's current password; if the account does not have a password, this sets it

JSON Params.name: change_phone_reason
JSON Params.description: The [removal reason](#change-phone-reason)

endpoints.title: Register Device
endpoints.description: Registers an FCM/APNs push notification token for the client's device. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

JSON Params.name: provider
JSON Params.description: The [push notification provider](#push-notification-provider) of the device

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The push notification token to register

JSON Params.name: voip_provider? ^1^
JSON Params.description: The VOIP [push notification provider](#push-notification-provider) of the device

JSON Params.name: voip_token? ^1^
JSON Params.description: The VOIP push notification token to register

JSON Params.name: bypass_server_throttling_supported
JSON Params.description: Whether the client supports bypassing server throttling for push notifications (default false)

JSON Params.name: bundle_id
JSON Params.description: The bundle ID of the app (default com.discord)

endpoints.title: Unregister Device
endpoints.description: Unregisters an FCM/APNs push notification token for the client's device. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

JSON Params.name: provider
JSON Params.description: The [push notification provider](#push-notification-provider) of the device

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The push notification token to unregister

endpoints.title: Get Device Sync Token
endpoints.description: Returns a push notification sync token for the current user. This token can be used to synchronize push notification tokens across multiple accounts.

Response Body.name: token
Response Body.description: The push notification sync token

endpoints.title: Sync Devices
endpoints.description: Synchronizes the client's FCM/APNs push notification token across multiple accounts.

JSON Params.name: provider
JSON Params.description: The [push notification provider](#push-notification-provider) of the device

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The device push notification token

JSON Params.name: push_sync_tokens ^1^
JSON Params.description: Device sync tokens for each account

Response Body.name: invalid_push_sync_tokens
Response Body.description: Device sync tokens that are invalid

endpoints.title: Acknowledge Message
endpoints.description: Updates the channel's read state for the current user. Fires a [Message Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#message-ack) Gateway event. The message ID parameter does not need to be a valid message ID, but it must be a valid snowflake. If the message ID is being set to a message sent prior to the latest acknowledged one, `manual` should be `true` or the resulting read state update might be ignored by clients, resulting in undefined behavior. In this case, `mention_count` should also be updated to the amount of mentions unacknowledged as it is not automatically calculated by Discord.

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The last received [ack token](#ack-tokens), or `null`

JSON Params.name: manual
JSON Params.description: Whether the acknowledged message ID is manually set

JSON Params.name: mention_count? ^1^
JSON Params.description: The new unread indicator for the channel

JSON Params.name: flags? ^2^
JSON Params.description: The [read state flags](#read-state-flags) for the channel

JSON Params.name: last_viewed? ^2^
JSON Params.description: When the channel was last viewed (in days since the Discord epoch)

Response Body.name: token
Response Body.description: The new [ack token](#ack-tokens)

endpoints.title: Acknowledge Pinned Messages
endpoints.description: Acknowledges the currently pinned messages in a channel. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a [Channel Pins Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#channel-pins-ack) Gateway event.

endpoints.title: Acknowledge Guild
endpoints.description: Updates all read states in a guild to acknowledge all features and messages. Fires multiple [Message Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#message-ack) and [Guild Feature Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-feature-ack) Gateway events.

endpoints.title: Acknowledge Guild Feature
endpoints.description: Updates a guild feature's read state for the current user. Fires a [Guild Feature Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-feature-ack) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The last received [ack token](#ack-tokens), or `null`

Response Body.name: token
Response Body.description: The new [ack token](#ack-tokens)

endpoints.title: Acknowledge User Feature
endpoints.description: Updates a non-channel feature's read state for the current user. Fires a [User Non Channel Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#user-non-channel-ack) Gateway event.

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The last received [ack token](#ack-tokens), or `null`

Response Body.name: token
Response Body.description: The new [ack token](#ack-tokens)

endpoints.title: Bulk Update Read States
endpoints.description: Updates multiple read states for the current user. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires multiple [Message Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#message-ack), [Guild Feature Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#guild-feature-ack), and [User Non Channel Ack](/gateway/gateway-events#user-non-channel-ack) Gateway events.

JSON Params.name: read_states
JSON Params.description: The read state updates to update

endpoints.title: Delete Read State
endpoints.description: Deletes a read state for the current user. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

JSON Params.name: read_state_type
JSON Params.description: The [read state type](#read-state-type) to delete (default `CHANNEL`)

JSON Params.name: version
JSON Params.description: The version of the read state protocol the client has implemented, used to prevent accidental deletions from outdated clients (currently 2)

endpoints.title: Get Report Reasons
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [report reason](#report-reason-structure) objects that can be used when creating a report for a message or user.

Query String Params.description: The ID of the message to report

Query String Params.name: channel_id
Query String Params.description: The ID of the channel the message is in

Query String Params.name: user_id
Query String Params.description: The ID of the user to report

endpoints.title: Create Report
endpoints.description: Creates a report for a message or user.

JSON Params.name: message_id ^1^
JSON Params.description: The ID of the message to report

JSON Params.name: channel_id ^1^
JSON Params.description: The ID of the channel the message is in

JSON Params.name: user_id ^1^
JSON Params.description: The ID of the user to report

JSON Params.description: The [report reason](#report-reason-structure) identifier

endpoints.title: Get Report Options
endpoints.description: Returns a list of [report option](#report-option-structure) objects that can be used when creating a report for a message.

endpoints.title: Stage Report
endpoints.description: Stages a report for a message, returning a token that can be used to create the report containing the serialized message data.

Response Body.name: token
Response Body.description: The signed report token

endpoints.title: Create Staged Report
endpoints.description: Creates a report for a message, including a snapshot of the message for review. Requires the `MANAGE_MESSAGES` permission if the channel is in a guild. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The signed report token

JSON Params.name: report_type
JSON Params.description: The [report option](#report-option-structure) value

JSON Params.name: report_subtype
JSON Params.description: The [report option sub-type](#report-option-sub-type-structure) value

JSON Params.name: subject
JSON Params.description: The subject of the report (max 300 characters)

JSON Params.name: description
JSON Params.description: Additional details for the report (max 800 characters)

endpoints.title: Get Report Menu
endpoints.description: Returns a [report menu](#report-menu-object) object for the specified [type](#report-menu-type). The menu contains a hierarchical tree of nodes that guide users through the reporting process, including questions, options, and submission steps.

Query String Params.name: variant
Query String Params.description: The version variant of the menu to retrieve (max 256 characters, default latest)

endpoints.title: Submit Report Menu
endpoints.description: Submits a completed report based on the user's navigation through a report menu. This endpoint processes the collected information from the menu flow and creates a formal report for review by Discord's Trust and Safety team.

JSON Params.name: version
JSON Params.description: The version of the report menu schema that was used

JSON Params.name: variant
JSON Params.description: The variant of the menu that was used

JSON Params.name: name
JSON Params.description: The [report menu type](#report-menu-type)

JSON Params.name: language
JSON Params.description: The language code used for the report

JSON Params.name: breadcrumbs
JSON Params.description: Node IDs clicked in the report menu flow, representing the user's path through the menu

JSON Params.name: elements
JSON Params.description: Map of [element names to their selected values](#report-element-type) (for checkboxes and other inputs)

JSON Params.name: channel_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the channel being reported (required for [`message`, `first_dm`, `stage_channel`, and `guild_directory_entry` report menus](#report-menu-type))

JSON Params.name: message_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the message being reported (required for [`message` and `first_dm` report menus](#report-menu-type))

JSON Params.name: guild_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the guild being reported (required for [`guild`, `stage_channel`, `guild_scheduled_event`, `guild_directory_entry`, and `guild_discovery` report menus](#report-menu-type))

JSON Params.name: stage_instance_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the stage instance being reported (required for [`stage_channel` report menus](#report-menu-type))

JSON Params.name: guild_scheduled_event_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the scheduled event being reported (required for [`guild_scheduled_event` report menus](#report-menu-type))

JSON Params.name: reported_user_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the user being reported (required for [`user` report menus](#report-menu-type))

JSON Params.name: application_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the application being reported (required for [`application` report menus](#report-menu-type))

JSON Params.name: user_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the user being reported (required for [`widget` report menus](#report-menu-type))

JSON Params.name: widget_id
JSON Params.description: The ID of the profile widget being reported (required for [`widget` report menus](#report-menu-type))

Response Body.name: report_id
Response Body.description: The ID of the created report

endpoints.title: Request Report Review
endpoints.description: Submits a request to have a report on your account reviewed. Report review links are present in emails sent informing you of actions taken on your account. When clicked, these links redirect to `https://discord.com/report-review?token=...`, where the token can be used with this endpoint to request a review. Returns an empty object on success.

JSON Params.name: token
JSON Params.description: The report review token obtained from the report review link
